subject: Mutual Action Plan: SOC 2 package delivery & security review roadmap
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@cedarcloud.com>, Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@cedarcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & MAP draft (SOC 2 milestones)

Hi Alex / Dana —

Thanks again for the call this morning. I wanted to capture the immediate next steps and drop the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan focused specifically on the security milestone (SOC 2 package + evidence). Attached: CedarCloud-MAP-draft-v2.xlsx — the tab labelled "Security/SOC2" has the milestone, owners, and proposed target dates.

Key points we agreed on:
- Redwood will deliver the SOC 2 evidence index and questionnaire responses as a single bundle for your security team to consume.
- Initial delivery target: Dec 10 (we proposed) — contingent on a quick review of the questionnaire and one short follow-up call to clarify a few artifact formats.
- Owners: Marissa (SOC 2 docs & evidence), Priyom (security architecture notes & config exports), Vivek (deal coordination & timelines).

Immediate asks for CedarCloud:
1) Confirm the internal reviewer(s) for SOC 2 (name & title).
2) Flag any additional artifact types beyond the list in the MAP (logs retention, third-party subprocessors, encryption key custody) — if you need different export formats or redaction guidance, tell us now.

Next steps I propose:
- Dana/Alex confirm reviewers by EOD Wed (Dec 1).
- Marissa to send SOC2-evidence-index.pdf + Security-Questionnaire-CedarCloud.xlsx by Dec 6.
- Quick 30-min sync on Dec 8 (if needed) to clear open Qs before bundle delivery on Dec 10.

I put the milestone in the MAP with a conservative buffer; if you want an earlier target we can compress tasks but will need your reviewers to be ready.

Thanks —
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162
Redwood Inference — production-first inference runtime
From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@cedarcloud.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@cedarcloud.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & MAP draft (SOC 2 milestones)

Thanks Vivek — this is useful.

Quick answers:
- Reviewer for CedarCloud: Dana Ortiz (Security Program Manager) and myself (Head of IT). We may also loop in our compliance director if anything looks unusual.
- Extra artifacts: encryption key custody statement (we prefer KMS/HSM details), sample retention policy for metrics logs, and a copy of PRD/architecture diagram that shows data flow from user input to stored embeddings.

We can confirm formally by EOD Wed. Dec 10 is acceptable if you can deliver the evidence index + questionnaire responses by Dec 6 as proposed.

One question: can the evidence index include expected file formats and approximate compressed sizes? Our security intake needs that for upload planning.

Also: do you have an internal point of contact for engineering-level questions (e.g., where to find specific config exports)? If so, please include them on the delivery email.

Appreciate the clarity — looking forward to the SOC 2 bundle.

Alex
Alex Nguyen
Head of IT Operations | CedarCloud
alex.nguyen@cedarcloud.com | +1 646-555-0188
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@cedarcloud.com>, Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@cedarcloud.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & MAP draft (SOC 2 milestones)

Hi Alex / Dana —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for flagging the extra artifacts. Short update on owners and formats:
- Marissa (me) — point owner for evidence index and packaging (I will produce a PDF index and a zipped folder with labeled subfolders). Expected compressed size: ~200–350 MB depending on logs we include.
- Priyom — will provide the architecture export (drawn diagram + sample config extracts), a brief KMS/HSM summary, and retention policy excerpts. Priyom, can you confirm the exact exports you plan to attach and whether any redaction is required?

Proposed SOC 2 milestone breakdown (mirrored in the MAP spreadsheet):
- Dec 3: Draft evidence index + list of artifacts to be delivered (owner: Marissa).
- Dec 6: Full evidence bundle (PDF index + zipped artifacts) delivered via secure Drive link (owner: Marissa).
- Dec 8: Optional 30-min technical clarifying call (owner: Priyom / CedarCloud engineering).
- Dec 10: Finalized delivery and close of the security milestone in the MAP (owner: Vivek).

Format notes:
- Evidence index will include a "file type" column (pdf/log/tar.gz), an "expected size" column, and a "redaction needed" flag.
- We will include a README with the export process for config artifacts so your engineers can validate quickly.

Priyom, tagging you below to confirm the exports and timeline.

Thanks —
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@cedarcloud.com>, Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@cedarcloud.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & MAP draft (SOC 2 milestones)

Alex / Dana —

Confirming I will assemble the following for the Dec 6 bundle:
- Architecture diagram (SVG + PDF) showing data flows and third-party integrations.
- KMS export summary: list of key types, KMS provider, who holds master keys (we store in customer-managed KMS for Private deployments; for hosted we have HSM-backed keys).
- Sample config extracts (redacted) for tokenization, storage endpoints, and logging exports.
- Retention policy excerpt for logs and embeddings.

Redaction: I will redact any internal hostnames and replace with placeholders; nothing else should be sensitive. If CedarCloud needs fully anonymized logs, flag it ASAP and we can scope effort.

I will upload artifacts to the Drive folder and include the SOC2-evidence-index.pdf with sizes/filenames. Expect secure link in my delivery email on Dec 6.

If you want the 30-min technical sync on Dec 8, propose 10:00–10:30 PT; Vivek / Marissa / I will join.

Thanks —
Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Staff Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com
